--आश्रम at, sacred to Nara-नारायण in Gan- धमादन; the place where Hari is said to perform तपस् for the welfare of the world; visited by कृष्ण; as directed by कृष्ण on the eve of his departure to Heaven, Uddhava made it his abode;
1: भा.

; Br. III. २५. ६७; Vi. V. ३७. ३४.
Kakudmi spent the evening of his life at that place.
2: भा.

. ३६
See बद्रिका. Here Mucukunda performed तपस् meditating on

: Ib. X. ५२. 4.
See बदरियाश्रम. A तीर्थ sacred to ऊर्वशी;
4: M. १३. ४९.
sacred to the पितृस्;
5: Ib. २२. ७३.
आश्रम where Mitra and वरुण performed penance.
6: Ib. २०१. २४.
--the name of the द्वीप where बादरायण was born. M. १४. १६.
--the sages of, visited द्वारका. भा. X. ९०. २८[5].
--व्यास; an incarnation of Acyuta; and who arranged the one Veda into different parts. भा.
--the गण consisting of the grandsons and great- grandsons of हिरण्याक्ष; killed in thousands in the तारका- maya. वा. ६७. ६९.
